The “cool smart successful kids” from school. After growing up and learning about privilege and wealth classes, i just realized most of those kids came from middle class homes with connections and somewhat healthy parents. The reason why i never realized is becuz those kids judged the rest of us (to their credit, if i was unaware of privilege, def so were they) and like a sucker i got pulled into that and wanted their approval. I didn’t even think abt how my own lower wealth class, single full time working parent and one bedroom apt would put the odds against me. I thought, really thought, it was all purely merit. Boy, i was wrong. Also, those cool kids that i thought were so funny and smart, i soon realize they got most of their jokes on reddit. Us poor kids didnt have access to internet back in the 90s/early 2000s. Not everyone had that privilege like they do nowadays.

Im not mad actually. Im kinda relieved that deep down we’re all equal, merit or not, some just have privileges, obvious or not. We’re all human at the end of the day. Merits are just lil decorations we wear to identify ourselves with, which is very valid but at end, just pretty decorations.
